build_optim_wrapper: build an OptimWrapper for a PyTorch model using a config dict with optimizer settings
register_torch_optimizers: register all torch.optim optimizer classes into the OPTIMIZERS registry and return their names
register_torch_npu_optimizers: register torch_npu.optim optimizer classes into the OPTIMIZERS registry on NPU hardware
register_dadaptation_optimizers: register DAdaptAdaGrad, DAdaptAdam, and DAdaptSGD from dadaptation into the OPTIMIZERS registry
register_bitsandbytes_optimizers: register 8-bit optimizers like AdamW8bit and PagedAdamW8bit from bitsandbytes into the OPTIMIZERS registry
